localizations.name: XCut AI
localizations.description: Find viral posts, outliers, hooks and ads on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook, then write.
localizations.summary: XCut AI is a hosted MCP server for social media content. Ask your AI what's going viral in a niche, which of a creator's or competitor's posts beat their own average, why a post worked (transcript and hook), and what ads run in the Meta Ad Library. Then write hooks, captions, scripts, carousels and content calendars in your brand's voice. 39 tools. Never posts to social media.

tools.name: xcut_find_hooks
tools.title: Find proven hooks
tools.description: Use this when the user wants hooks, opening lines or first sentences for a post, Reel, TikTok, Short, YouTube video or ad. Returns proven hook templates matched to the topic, from XcutAI's library of about 1,000 hooks taken from posts that performed, each with slots for the user's subject. The library and topic search are in English. Free; no sign-in. Do not use for formats, script structures or platform facts (use xcut_get_playbook) or for a finished caption (use xcut_write_caption).

topic.description: What the post is about, in English. e.g. 'pricing mistakes for small bakeries'
topic.title: Topic

category.description: Optional hook family to restrict to.
category.title: Category

tools.name: xcut_get_playbook
tools.title: Get a content playbook
tools.description: Use this when the user asks how to structure a Reel, TikTok, Short, YouTube video, carousel, caption, content plan, offer or ad, or how a platform's algorithm, hashtags or profile setup work. Call it before writing so the answer follows formats that performed. Returns beat-by-beat video formats with timings, storytelling and retention principles, hook families, paid-ad frameworks and platform facts including documented myths and hashtag limits. Free; no sign-in. Describe the goal in plain English with platform and format. Do not use for hook templates (use xcut_find_hooks).

goal.description: What is being made or decided, in English, with platform and format. e.g. 'instagram carousel that gets saved', 'tutorial reel structure', 'how many hashtags on instagram'
goal.title: Goal

kind.description: Optional: structure (formats), principle, hook_type, ad_framework or platform_fact.
kind.title: Kind

tools.name: xcut_hook_ideas
tools.title: Hook ideas
tools.description: Use this when the user wants 10 new hook variations written for their niche and topic on YouTube, TikTok or Instagram. For proven hook templates from posts that performed, use xcut_find_hooks. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

platform.description: Where the hooks will be used.
platform.title: Platform

niche.description: The creator's niche, e.g. "fitness for busy moms".
niche.title: Niche

tools.name: xcut_write_caption
tools.title: Write caption
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a finished caption (hook, body, CTA and hashtags) for an Instagram, TikTok or YouTube Shorts post from a short concept. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

platform.description: Where the caption will be posted.
platform.title: Platform

concept.description: What the post shows or says, in a sentence or two.
concept.title: Concept

tools.name: xcut_rewrite_bio
tools.title: Rewrite bio
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their profile bio rewritten for Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, X or LinkedIn. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

platform.description: Which profile the bio is for.
platform.title: Platform

current_bio.description: The bio as it reads today.

niche.description: The creator's niche, if not obvious from the bio.

Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

topic.title: Topic

tools.name: xcut_analyze_script
tools.title: Analyze script
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a script scored on its hook, pacing, retention risk and CTA. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

script.description: The full script to score (at least 50 characters).
script.title: Script

tools.name: xcut_audit_content
tools.title: Audit content
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a consistency check across 3 to 10 of their past titles or captions. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

titles_or_captions.description: 3 to 10 past titles or captions, one per item.
titles_or_captions.title: Titles Or Captions

platform.description: Platform they were posted on, e.g. "instagram"; "general" if mixed.
platform.title: Platform

tools.name: xcut_posting_plan
tools.title: Posting plan

It is a text plan only; to put posts on the user's XcutAI calendar use xcut_add_to_calendar. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

platform.description: Which platform the plan is for.
platform.title: Platform

content_pillars.description: 1 to 5 themes the account posts about.
content_pillars.title: Content Pillars

tools.name: xcut_competitor_gaps
tools.title: Competitor gaps
tools.description: Use this when the user wants content gaps versus named competitors in their niche. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

tools.name: xcut_check_niche
tools.title: Check niche
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know whether a niche is viable before committing to it. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

niche_description.description: The niche to check, described in a sentence or two.
niche_description.title: Niche Description

tools.name: xcut_repurpose_content
tools.title: Repurpose content
tools.description: Use this when the user wants one piece of content turned into TikTok, Reel, LinkedIn, X and email angles. Free; no sign-in. Output is generic: for work based on the user's own posts, canvases or brand, use the signed-in XcutAI tools. Do not use for writing unrelated to social media or marketing content.

title.description: Title of the piece to repurpose.
title.title: Title

description.description: What the piece covers, optional but gives better angles.
description.title: Description

tools.name: xcut_get_account
tools.title: Get account and credits
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about their XcutAI plan, credit balance, monthly allowance, next refill date or trial, or before starting an import or analysis that costs credits. Free. Do not use for usage history (that is in XcutAI Settings, not available here).

tools.name: xcut_list_canvases
tools.title: List canvases
tools.description: Use this when you need a canvas id or the user asks what XcutAI canvases (projects) they have, including ones shared with them, newest first. Free. Do not call it just to import a post or write: those tools use the user's "From AI apps" canvas when no canvas is named.

include_shared.description: Also list canvases shared with the user.
include_shared.title: Include Shared

tools.name: xcut_get_canvas
tools.title: Get a canvas
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is on one of their XcutAI canvases: its items (imported posts, notes, chats, groups, Meta ads, analytics tables, websites, media) with ids, counts by type and short previews. Filter with `item_type`; paginate with `offset`. Free. Do not use to read an item in full (use xcut_get_content).

offset.description: Items to skip, for paging through a large canvas. Default 0.
offset.title: Offset

item_type.description: Only list this kind of item.
item_type.title: Item Type

tools.name: xcut_create_canvas
tools.title: Create a canvas
tools.description: Use this when the user asks for a new, separate XcutAI canvas for a project, client or campaign. Returns its id. Free. Do not use just to import or write: those tools pick a canvas automatically.

name.description: Name for the new canvas, e.g. "Q4 launch" or "Client: Glow Skincare".
name.title: Name

tools.name: xcut_get_brand
tools.title: Get brand memory
tools.description: Use this when you are about to write for the user's brand and need its voice, niche, audience and offer, or the user asks what XcutAI knows about their brand. Returns the canvas's brand profile and saved memory facts with ids. Free. Do not use for public creators the user does not own (use xcut_find_outliers or xcut_search_viral).

canvas_id.description: Canvas id (a UUID) from xcut_list_canvases. The brand attached to this canvas is returned.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_save_memory
tools.title: Save a brand memory fact
tools.description: Use this when the user states a lasting fact about their brand (voice, audience, offer, constraint, posting schedule) so every XcutAI agent uses it from now on. Adds a new fact; never changes or removes one. Free. Do not use to change an existing fact (use xcut_update_memory) or for one-off instructions that apply only to the current request.

canvas_id.description: Canvas id (a UUID) from xcut_list_canvases. The fact is saved to this canvas's brand.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

text.description: The fact, in one or two sentences.
text.title: Text

category.description: What kind of fact it is.
category.title: Category

tools.name: xcut_update_memory
tools.title: Update a brand memory fact
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to change a saved brand memory fact. Replaces that fact's text and category (the old text is not kept). Needs the fact's id from xcut_get_brand. Free. Do not use to add a new fact (use xcut_save_memory).

memory_id.description: Id of the fact to change, from xcut_get_brand.
memory_id.title: Memory Id

category.description: New kind of fact. Omit to keep the current one.
category.title: Category

tools.name: xcut_delete_memory
tools.title: Delete a brand memory fact
tools.description: Use this when the user asks to remove a saved brand memory fact from XcutAI. Needs the fact's id from xcut_get_brand. Do not use to change a fact (use xcut_update_memory).

memory_id.description: Id of the memory fact to remove, from xcut_get_brand.
memory_id.title: Memory Id

tools.name: xcut_list_calendar
tools.title: List calendar posts
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what content is planned or scheduled: posts on their XcutAI content calendar between two dates, optionally for one canvas, with status (draft, in review, approved, scheduled, published). Free. Do not use for posts already live on social media (use xcut_profile_analytics).

canvas_id.description: Only posts planned for this canvas (UUID). Omit for all canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_add_to_calendar
tools.title: Add a post to the calendar
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a planned post saved to their XcutAI content calendar: title, platform, type, date, and optionally caption and hashtags. Saved as a draft unless a status is given. Free. Do not use to publish: XcutAI never posts to social media.

title.description: Short working title, e.g. "3 myths about retinol".
title.title: Title

platform.description: Where it will be posted: instagram, facebook, tiktok, youtube or meta (Meta ads).
platform.title: Platform

post_type.description: Format: post, image, video, carousel, reel, story, idea, script or ad. Default post.
post_type.title: Post Type

caption.description: Full caption or script text, if written.
caption.title: Caption

hashtags.description: Hashtags without spaces, e.g. ["#skincare", "#retinol"]. Up to 30.
hashtags.title: Hashtags

canvas_id.description: Canvas (UUID) the post belongs to. Optional.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

status.description: draft, in_review, approved, scheduled or published. Default draft. Setting it never publishes anything.
status.title: Status

annotations.title: Add a post to the calendar

tools.name: xcut_update_calendar_post
tools.title: Update a calendar post
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to change a post on their XcutAI calendar: date, caption, hashtags, title, type or status (for example mark it approved). Only the fields given change; their old values are not kept. Free. Do not use to publish: XcutAI never posts to social media.

post_id.description: Id (UUID) of the calendar post, from xcut_list_calendar.
post_id.title: Post Id

scheduled_at.description: New date and time in ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-11-03T18:00:00Z".
scheduled_at.title: Scheduled At

hashtags.description: New hashtag list; replaces the old one. Up to 30.
hashtags.title: Hashtags

post_type.description: New format: post, image, video, carousel, reel, story, idea, script or ad.
post_type.title: Post Type

status.description: New status: draft, in_review, approved, scheduled or published. Never publishes anything.
status.title: Status

tools.name: xcut_delete_calendar_post
tools.title: Delete a calendar post
tools.description: Use this when the user explicitly asks to remove a post from their XcutAI content calendar. Do not use to reschedule or edit (use xcut_update_calendar_post).

post_id.description: Id (UUID) of the calendar post to remove, from xcut_list_calendar.
post_id.title: Post Id

tools.name: xcut_get_breakouts
tools.title: Get breakout alerts and trends
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is breaking out or trending in their own niche right now: XcutAI's breakout alerts from the accounts on their watchlist, plus trending keywords, from the last scan. Free. Do not use for a topic or creator outside their watchlist (use xcut_search_viral).

limit.description: Most breakout alerts to return, 1-50. Default 20.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: xcut_scan_watchlist
tools.title: Scan watched accounts now
tools.description: Use this when the user wants fresh breakouts now instead of waiting for the daily scan. Rescans the accounts on their XcutAI watchlist; allowed once an hour; costs 1 credit per account. Set `estimate` to true to get the cost without scanning. Do not use to read the latest results (use xcut_get_breakouts).

estimate.description: true returns the credit cost without scanning. Default false.
estimate.title: Estimate

tools.name: xcut_search_viral
tools.title: Search the viral library
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is going viral, trending or performing right now on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook for a topic or niche, what a creator posts that works, or what ads run in the Meta Ad Library. `mode` is keyword (a topic) or profile (an account). Returns posts with views, engagement, links and captions, plus `next_cursor` for more. 2 credits per page (cached pages free). Do not use for general web or news search, or for one profile's outliers versus its own normal (use xcut_find_outliers).

platform.description: instagram, tiktok, youtube, facebook, or meta_ads for the Meta Ad Library.
platform.title: Platform

query.description: A topic, or a handle when mode is profile.
query.title: Query

mode.description: keyword to search a topic (e.g. "meal prep"), or profile to see an account's top posts (query = @handle). Default keyword. Facebook supports profile only.
mode.title: Mode

tools.name: xcut_find_outliers
tools.title: Find a profile's outlier posts
tools.description: Use this when the user asks which of a creator's, competitor's or their own posts performed best or beat the account's normal, or what works for an account before writing. Scores the latest 20, 30, 50 or 100 posts against that account's own median and says by how much each beat it. About 1 credit per post. Longer runs return a `job_id` for xcut_get_job. Do not use for a full metrics table (use xcut_profile_analytics) or for a topic across many accounts (use xcut_search_viral).

posts.description: How many recent posts to analyse: 20, 30, 50 or 100. Default 30.
posts.title: Posts

canvas_id.description: Canvas (UUID) that owns the thumbnails. Optional. The results are returned here, not placed on the canvas.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_profile_analytics
tools.title: Get profile analytics
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an account's per-post metrics (views, likes, comments, shares, engagement) over the last N posts or days, for a performance review or to compare accounts on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook. Credit cost depends on platform and post count. Longer runs return a `job_id` for xcut_get_job. Do not use to find standout posts (use xcut_find_outliers).

days.description: Or: posts from the last N days.
days.title: Days

canvas_id.description: Canvas (UUID) that owns the thumbnails. Optional. The table is returned here, not placed on the canvas.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_get_job
tools.title: Check a job
tools.description: Use this when another XcutAI tool returned a `job_id`: it returns status `running` with a suggested wait, or the finished result (outlier analysis, profile analytics, imports with their transcript, agent replies). Free. Do not use without a `job_id` from an XcutAI tool.

job_id.description: The `job_id` an XcutAI tool returned, unchanged.
job_id.title: Job Id

tools.name: xcut_import_post
tools.title: Import a social post
tools.description: Use this when the user shares an Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook post or video link and wants its transcript, a breakdown of why it worked, or their own version of it. XcutAI transcribes the video and reads the caption, visuals and stats. Don't ask which canvas: with none named it goes to the user's "From AI apps" canvas. 2 credits plus transcription (a few credits for a short video). Returns a `job_id`; xcut_get_job returns the transcript when done. Do not use for website links (use xcut_import_website) or Meta Ad Library links (use xcut_import_meta_ad).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_import_website
tools.title: Import a website
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a web page (product page, landing page, article) to use as context for writing their content. XcutAI reads the page and stores its text on a canvas. 1 credit. Returns a short preview. Do not use for social media post links (use xcut_import_post).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_import_meta_ad
tools.title: Import a Meta ad
tools.description: Use this when the user shares a Meta Ad Library link (facebook.com/ads/library) and wants the ad's copy, media and video transcript to study or remix. Holds up to 12 credits and charges the real cost. May return a `job_id` for xcut_get_job. Do not use for organic Facebook posts (use xcut_import_post).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_import_profile
tools.title: Import a profile's recent posts
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to study a creator's or brand's recent posts in depth (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook): it adds them to a canvas as a group and transcribes and analyses each. About 1 credit per post plus transcription. Returns a `job_id` while the profile is read. Do not use just to rank posts (use xcut_find_outliers).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_add_note
tools.title: Add a note to a canvas
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a script, hook list, plan or other text saved to XcutAI. Accepts Markdown; with no canvas named it goes to the user's "From AI apps" canvas. Free. Do not use for calendar posts (use xcut_add_to_calendar).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

annotations.title: Add a note to a canvas

tools.name: xcut_get_content
tools.title: Read an imported item
tools.description: Use this when you need the full content of an item on the user's XcutAI canvas, by canvas id and item id (from xcut_get_canvas): a post or video's transcript and stats, a note, a chat's messages (paginate with `before`), a website's text, an analytics table, a Meta ad, or a group's contents. Free. Do not use to list a canvas (use xcut_get_canvas).

item_id.description: Item id from xcut_get_canvas, or the `item_id` an import returned.
item_id.title: Item Id

before.description: Chats only: message id to page back from.
before.title: Before

tools.name: xcut_write_content
tools.title: Write with an XcutAI agent
tools.description: Use this when the user wants XcutAI's agents to write for their brand: Reels, TikTok and Shorts scripts, YouTube scripts, Facebook posts, Meta ad copy, hooks, captions or plans, using their brand memory, imported posts and XcutAI's library of formats that performed. The conversation is saved to their canvas. Pick `agent` for the platform, or auto. Token-billed (typically 10-40 credits). Longer turns return a `job_id`. Do not use for writing unrelated to the user's social media or marketing content.

request.description: What to write, as the user would ask in the canvas chat.
request.title: Request

agent.description: Which XcutAI writer to use: auto (picks from the request), instagram, tiktok, youtube_script, youtube_shorts, facebook, meta_ad or general. Default auto.
agent.title: Agent

item_ids.description: Only use these canvas items (default: the whole canvas).
item_ids.title: Item Ids

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas, where imports also land. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_run_playbook
tools.title: Run an XcutAI playbook
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a ready-made content deliverable from what is on their canvas: a month or week content plan, 25 hooks, 3 scripts, breakout remix, competitor teardown or benchmark, prospect audit, ad-angle gap map, ad creatives, carousel or thumbnail concepts. Token-billed (a month plan is roughly 30-60 credits). Longer runs return a `job_id`. Do not use for a single custom request (use xcut_write_content).

playbook.description: month or week (content plan), hooks (25 hooks), scripts (3 scripts), remix (breakout remix), teardown, benchmark, audit (prospect audit), angles (ad-angle gap map), adcreatives, carousel or thumbnails.
playbook.title: Playbook

platform.description: The platform to write for, when the playbook follows one.
platform.title: Platform

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas, where imports also land. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

tools.name: xcut_generate_image
tools.title: Generate an image
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a social media image made or edited: post graphic, carousel slide, thumbnail or ad visual, from a prompt and optional reference image links. Needs the Starter plan or higher; about 10 credits per image. Do not use for images unrelated to the user's content or marketing.

prompt.description: What to make or change, e.g. "bold carousel cover: '3 retinol myths', pink gradient, large serif headline".
prompt.title: Prompt

aspect_ratio.description: 1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 16:9, 3:4 or 4:3. Default 1:1 (use 4:5 for Instagram feed, 9:16 for Reels and Stories).
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

reference_image_urls.description: Up to 5 public https image links to guide style or to edit.
reference_image_urls.title: Reference Image Urls
